final_answer:
in a quiet forest, a tortoise named tico watched birds soar above the trees. he admired their freedom and longed to fly, though his slow pace made him doubt his dreams. one day, he found a feather and fashioned wings from leaves and vines. “i will learn to fly,” he declared, ignoring the whispers of doubt.  

tico practiced daily, climbing hills to leap into the air. his first attempts ended in clumsy crashes, but he persisted. a wise owl, observing from a branch, warned, “flight is not for all. some are meant to walk, others to glide.” tico laughed, “i will prove you wrong!” yet, no matter how hard he tried, his wings could not lift him.  

despite his efforts, tico’s body was not built for flight. one day, as he lay exhausted, he realized the owl was right. “perhaps my strength lies not in the sky, but in the ground,” he mused. he returned to his steady pace, content with his own path.  

moral: not all dreams are meant to be chased. know your limits, and find joy in your own unique journey.
